systems.system: AES biometric national identity card enrolment
systems.country_label: Carte nationale d'identité biométrique de l'Alliance des États du Sahel (CNIB AES)
systems.owner: Police nationale takes the applications; cards are made in central workshops in Niamey
systems.tiers: Enrolment opened 2026-09-15 at the regional directorate of the national police in Agadez; fingerprints and biometrics captured locally and the file sent digitally to Niamey; payment through Airtel Money, Amana and NITA

note: The regional police directorate appears only as the enrolment site for the civil identity card, which no typology class covers; nothing on reports or cases recorded at a station.
